description: A "Toss" frame allows users to flip a virtual coin or perform a random selection between two options. It's a fun and interactive way to make decisions or settle disputes. Users can simply click or tap on the frame to initiate the toss, and the result (heads or tails, option 1 or option 2) is displayed in an animated manner. Toss frames can be customized with various themes, animations, and sound effects to enhance the user experience. They are commonly used in games, decision-making apps, or as a playful element in websites or social media platforms. With Neynar's Toss frame capabilities, developers can easily create and integrate toss functionality into their applications with minimal effort.
